children: On March 31, 2027, edgeX unlocks 140.82 million EDGE for an airdrop after a 12-month lock-up. The tokens being released are equal to 40.23% of the circulating supply before the unlock.

The unlock increases the amount of EDGE available to trade. Existing holders can keep the same number of tokens and still own a smaller share of the circulating supply. If airdrop recipients sell their tokens, those sales can add pressure on the price of EDGE.

title: edgeX: Unlocks 140.82 million EDGE for an airdrop - 31 Mar 2027
